description: Propose deleting a Moxie Docs-tracked documentation file that your change makes irrelevant, as part of YOUR current change. Moxie Docs validates the path and returns it for you to delete in your working branch; Moxie Docs itself does not delete files or open a PR - the deletion happens in your branch, so it lands in the SAME PR as the code. Returns the resolved path to delete. Provide either slug or targetPath.

reason.description: Why this doc is no longer relevant.

removedSourcePaths.description: Code paths being deleted that made this doc irrelevant, for provenance.

repository.description: The target repository as "owner/name" (e.g. "acme/app"). Always pass this unless your token is scoped to a single repository. Matching is case-insensitive. If omitted when the token serves multiple repos, the call returns the list of repositories to choose from instead of an answer.

slug.description: Slug of the existing generated doc to remove.

targetPath.description: Repository-relative path of the doc to remove (must be a Moxie Docs-tracked doc). Use instead of slug.

name: moxie.propose_doc_removal
